strings.EGY_THENEWORDER_DESC: Egypt's days as the center of global civilization are long, long over, but King Farouk I knows that to be successful you have to look successful, and what looks more like success than fast cars and cans of caviar? Whether his nation can afford to subsidize his... tastes... in the long term is debatable, but so long as the taxes are paid and the grain shipped, Egypt's Italian masters don't much mind its king's extravagance. Unfortunately, there are many who oppose the king's rule, either in the name of revolutionary fervour or reactionary fanaticism - but both are more than willing to take advantage of a ruler who much prefers cavorting and carriages to actual leadership. When the festivities reach their conclusion and the sun rises on the gilded ruins, will you have the strength and discipline to help Egypt navigate the next decade into true prosperity?
strings.EGY_1045_settler_part: and a melting pot of other European cultures, composed of Italian and French minorities, among others
strings.EGY_farouks_hedonism_desc: Our King, Farouk I, is known the world over for his extravagance and prodigal habits. Purported to eat over 600 oysters a week, Farouk is more of a playboy than a King. This has led to dissatisfaction with the King, and is also a big drain on the economy of the State.
